metas.name: The Tom and Jerry Show
metas.description: A cat-and-mouse brawl chasing each other.

metas.name: The New Tom & Jerry Show
metas.description: A modern continuation of the original Tom and Jerry cartoon, where the cat-and-mouse duo are now close friends through a series of adventures and chaos.

metas.name: Tom & Jerry Kids Show
metas.description: An updated version of the classic Tom & Jerry cartoons from 1940s/ 1950s. The 'kids' in these cartoons are far less violent than their parents were, but still find ways to cause plenty of trouble for each other and everyone else a...

metas.name: The Flintstones
metas.description: The misadventures of two modern-day Stone Age families, the Flintstones and the Rubbles.

metas.name: The Jetsons
metas.description: The misadventures of a futuristic family.

metas.name: Scooby Doo, Where Are You!
metas.description: Four teenage friends, (Fred Jones, Daphne Blake, Velma Dinkley, and Norville "Shaggy" Rogers), and their talking dog, (Scooby-Doo), travel around in their van, The Mystery Machine, solving strange, spooky, and hilariously kooky my...

metas.name: What's New, Scooby-Doo?
metas.description: Mystery Inc. teammates Shaggy, Scooby, Velma, Daphne and Fred have creepy adventures and new mysteries to solve. Always meeting some monster or ghost, the band of teens have gadgets and inventions that help on their detective adve...

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Mystery Incorporated
metas.description: This incarnation finds Scooby and the gang living in Crystal Cove, a small town with a long history of ghost sightings, monster tales and other mysteries ripe for the sleuths to solve once and for all.

metas.name: Animaniacs
metas.description: The zany adventures of a trio of 1930s animated characters in the modern world.

metas.name: Pinky and the Brain
metas.description: Pinky and the Brain are genetically enhanced laboratory mice who live in Acme Labs. The Brain is self-centered and scheming; Pinky is good-natured but feeble-minded. In each episode, the Brain devises a new plan to take over the w...

metas.name: Tiny Toon Adventures
metas.description: The wacky adventures of the new young hip generation of Warner Brothers Looney Tunes characters, most of them descendants of the original classic toon cast.

metas.name: Freakazoid!
metas.description: Washington, D.C. has a new defender: Freakazoid. The comedy and insanity never stop when he's around, and he's only one of the weird heroes of the series. It's better than a nice tub of good things.

metas.name: Inspector Gadget
metas.description: A bumbling cyborg inspector outfitted with an array of bizarre gadgets pursues the criminal organization M.A.D., all while his precocious niece and dog do the real investigative work.

metas.name: The Smurfs
metas.description: The Smurfs are tiny blue creatures that live in mushroom houses in a peaceful forest. They repeatedly try to outwit Gargamel, an evil sorcerer, his apprentice, Scruple, and his mangy cat, Azrael.

metas.name: Top Cat
metas.description: Top Cat is the leader of a group of alley cats, always trying to cheat someone.

metas.name: The Yogi Bear Show
metas.description: Yogi, a smooth, talkative forest bear looks to raid park goers' picnic baskets, while Park Ranger Smith tries to stop him.

metas.name: Hong Kong Phooey
metas.description: A kung-fu-fighting pup and his snickering cat sidekick battle crime.

metas.name: Garfield and Friends
metas.description: Stories about Garfield the cat, Odie the dog, their owner Jon and the trouble they get into, and Orson the Pig and his adventures on a farm with fellow farm animals.

metas.name: The Bugs Bunny Show
metas.description: TV series featuring the classic Looney Tunes animated shorts.

metas.name: The Road Runner Show
metas.description: A scheming coyote, constantly at odds with a swift and clever roadrunner bird, uses various gadgets and devices to try and catch his longtime rival.

metas.name: Popeye the Sailor
metas.description: The continuing animated adventures of Olive Oyl, Wimpy, Swee'pea and Popeye.

metas.name: The Looney Tunes Show
metas.description: An updated iteration of the classic Looney Tunes characters focusing on their satirical misadventures living in suburbia.
